sentences.text: ----Petitioner Versus 1. The State Of Rajasthan, Through Pp 2. Puna Ram S/o Jeetaji Choudhary, R/o Badsa, Tehsil Marwar Junction, Dist. Pali
----Respondents For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Firoz Khan For Respondent(s) : Mr. Abhishek Purohit GA-cum-AAG JUSTICE FARJAND ALI Order 16/11/2023 1.
The jurisdiction of this Court has been invoked by way of filing an application under Section 439 Cr.P.C. at the instance of accused-petitioner.

The requisite details of the matter are tabulated herein below:
S.No. Particulars of the Case  2. Concerned Police Station Marwar Junction  3. District Pali  4. Offences alleged in the FIR Under Sections 420, 467,
468 and 471 IPC  5. Offences added, if any 120-B IPC 6. Date of passing of impugned 31.10.2023 order [2023:RJ-JD:39239] (2 of 3)

] 
2. Learned Public Prosecutor submits that the victim/complainant of the case has been intimated regarding hearing of the bail plea telephonically.
However, no one has turned up on his/her behalf.
3. It is contended on behalf of the accused-petitioner that the offences alleged are triable by a Court of magistrate.
No case for the alleged offences is made out against him and his incarceration is not warranted.
There are no factors at play in the case at hand that may work against grant of bail to the accused-petitioner and he has been made accused based on conjectures and surmises.

sentences.text: 4. Contrary to the submissions of learned counsel for the petitioners, learned Public Prosecutor opposes the bail application and submits that the present case is not fit for enlargement of accused on bail.
5. I have considered the submissions made by both the parties and have perused the material available on record.
The highest allegation against the petitioner is that he had sold the property to one another person during existence of a sale with a previous buyer.
The offences alleged are triable by a Court of magistrate.

This Court has elaborately dealt with the bail jurisprudence pertaining to offences which are triable by a court of Magistrate and has passed a detailed order in Dharmendra vs. State of Rajasthan (S.B. Criminal Miscellaneous Bail Application No.11530/2023) vide order dated 07.10.2023.

entities.text: Dharmendra vs. State of Rajasthan (S.B. Criminal Miscellaneous Bail Application No.11530/2023)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
In view of the deliberation and enunciation made therein and since there is high probability that the trial [2023:RJ-JD:39239] (3 of 3) [CRLMB-14453/2023] may take long time to conclude, it is deemed suitable to grant the benefit of bail to the petitioner in the present matter.
6.

Accordingly, the instant bail application under Section 439 Cr.P.C. is allowed and it is ordered that the accused-petitioner as named in the cause title shall be enlarged on bail provided he furnishes a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- with two sureties of Rs.25,000/- each to the satisfaction of the learned trial Judge for his appearance before the court concerned on all the dates of hearing as and when called upon to do so.

(FARJAND ALI),J 112-Mamta/-
